sources.location: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pride/ws/archive/v2/projects/PXD002431/files?pageSize=1000 (33 entries: 32 RAW + evidence.zip; all projectAccessions = PXD002431)
PMC4857386 (Europe PMC fullTextXML); Secher A et al., Nat Commun 2016;7:11436, doi 10.1038/ncomms11436, PMID 27142507

https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2016/05/PXD002431/evidence.zip :: evidence.txt (375,878 rows; columns Raw File, Experiment, Gel Slice, Modifications, per-modification counts, Sequence summarised by script)

claims.evidence: All 32 deposited RAW files are listed once; MaxQuant Raw File names equal the deposited stems; RAW headers give the same original acquisition file names
Methods: 'In the main study, 32 rats were perfused...'; Results call them biological replica; evidence.txt maps each file to its own Experiment S01..S32 matching the file suffix
Methods: 'Sprague-Dawley rats (Crl:SD, male, 200 g, Charles River, Germany)'; MeSH 'Rats, Sprague-Dawley'. PRIDE's 'Rattus rattus' (NEWT:10117) is contradicted
Methods: 'hypothalami from all groups were sub-dissected'; MeSH Hypothalamus; run-name token 'hypot'; UBERON:0001898
Untreated healthy rats; no disease model described
Peptides extracted from whole hypothalamic tissue
Only body weight (200 g) is reported; no age or stage
RAW header 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS' (S1, S17, S32); Methods 'LTQ-Orbitrap Velos'; PRIDE MS:1001742
RAW method '220min_Top10HCD_JESPER_Special.meth'; Methods 'top10 ... HCD fragmentation method'

claims.location: comment[ms2 mass analyzer] / comment[ms1 scan range] rows 1-32
claims.evidence: Methods: full scan 350-1,750 m/z; HCD-MS/MS recorded at resolution 7,500 (Orbitrap)
Endogenous peptides (urea extraction + YM-30 cut-off filtration, no digestion); search 'no enzyme specificity'; evidence.txt peptide C-termini show no K/R bias (top: L, A, F, V, Y)
No reduction/alkylation in Methods; no Carbamidomethyl or other fixed modification in the deposited search output

claims.value: Acetyl UNIMOD:1 Protein N-term; Oxidation UNIMOD:35 M; Amidated UNIMOD:2 Any C-term; Phospho UNIMOD:21 STY; Gln->pyro-Glu UNIMOD:28 Q Any N-term; all Variable
claims.evidence: evidence.txt per-modification columns and Modifications values list exactly these five; Methods list the same variable modifications

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance] rows 1-32
claims.evidence: Methods: 'initial precursor ion tolerance of 7 p.p.m. and MS/MS tolerance at 0.02 Da'
Methods 'Label-free peptide quantification'; PRIDE quantification 'Spectrum counting'
One unfractionated injection per sample; evidence.txt Gel Slice = 1 for all rows

limitations: No factor value column: the deposit is a single-condition study (32 identically treated rats)
Paper does not explicitly state that run S<n> is rat n; mapping rests on 32 rats = 32 runs = 32 MaxQuant experiments and the paper's description of them as biological replicates
Developmental stage not reported (only 200 g body weight)
Tolerances and collision energy taken from Methods only; no MaxQuant parameter file (mqpar.xml/summary.txt/parameters.txt) is deposited
evidence.txt has a 'Glutathione (C) Site IDs' header but no rows or count column for it; not annotated
RAW headers read for 3 of 32 files (S1, S17, S32)
sdrf-tools reconcile reports cleavage_agent_unsupported for 'not applicable'; judged a false positive (reserved word read as an enzyme name)
